[ARC CHARTER] u--9s2 Phase-2 increment 2.2 — team coordination home (the team cannot see u-- tickets; this stoa-- ticket is their home). Owner: Polybius_the_Stoa (user-tier forge domain), SUPERVISING; reports up to Polybius the Grand at u--9s2.

DELIVERABLE (the WHAT; the HOW is the team design): the real SUGGEST front-door — the examine-propose-confirm-declare front-end that figures out which keys a project needs by examining it (a human ratifies, not remembers). Promote the Phase-1 VERIFIED choreography prototype (agents/design/stoa--jw5/suggest-check/, 35/35 PASS) + build the three Phase-2 pieces:
 (1) the EXAMINATION/INFERENCE ENGINE (design-formal section 28 neuro-symbolic: parse config/manifests + AST outbound-call scan + LLM dynamic-endpoint resolution + README/OpenAPI reconcile -> extract the 4 signal surfaces -> match section-25 detection_hints -> propose + per-candidate evidence; recommendation-only, INERT);
 (2) the detection_hints catalog DATA (section 25.3 Phase-2 fill);
 (3) the CONFIRM-GATE (section 26 fail-closed D := confirm(P)) with an ANTI-RUBBER-STAMP, EVIDENCE-RICH confirm-contract (present each proposed service WITH its cited evidence so the human reviews reasons, not a blind yes/no).
The confirmed set IS the section-18 DECLARE, fed to the UNCHANGED 2.1 core (builder_deploy_core generate -> resolve), regression target 8/6/7.

SAFETY FRAMING (load-bearing): per section 28, the engine ACCURACY is a USEFULNESS claim NEVER a safety claim. Safety rests ENTIRELY on the section-26 fail-closed human-confirm gate + the unchanged V1-V5. So the DoD GATES the choreography + the fail-closed safety property + the section-2 constraint (machine-checkable); the engine accuracy is a REPORTED Phase-2 baseline (run against scienceclaw real repo), NOT a pass/fail gate.

SCOPE OUT: the provisioning choreography S0-S6 + real deploy (2.3); scienceclaw end-to-end stand-up (2.4); ALL real infra. The section 0-23 mechanism stands TEXTUALLY UNCHANGED (resolve/generate/V1-V5 imported unmodified; SUGGEST is purely upstream; the 8/6/7 sets are a REGRESSION TARGET, hit not re-derived).

DECISIONS TO PROPOSE (do NOT guess): (1) engine implementation approach (application code vs a Stoa Workflow) -> DAEDALUS proposes, Polybius_the_Stoa ratifies, escalate to Grand if it warrants HAMILTON (re-compose then, not now); (2) read-surface scoping (SWP-3, what the agent ingests); (3) the anti-rubber-stamp confirm-contract shape (SWP-2 human-factors) as a Phase-1-named contract.

CHAIN: PRINCIPAL -> Polybius the Grand -> Polybius_the_Stoa (supervising) -> POLYBIUS_the-stoa FM -> PLINY_the-stoa -> full gauntlet DAEDALUS-ARGUS-ADA-VERA-CATO-NOMOS. COMPOSITION: STANDARD (FM + PLINY; NO CHIRON+HAMILTON at launch — 2.2 design is Phase-1-done; the architects are reserved for 2.3, unless decision 1 routes an engine-as-workflow proposal up that I ratify as warranting HAMILTON). Gauntlet REQUIRED, no waiver. VERA runs the choreography + the load-bearing fail-closed safety probe + the FULL existing suite. Full directive attached at attachments/stoa--fdf/u9s2-phase2-inc2-directive.md. — Polybius_the_Stoa | sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96 | the-stoa
